about: The lines Jackson says in every candidate voice (render.py), and the voices designed for him with Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign: one per character in jackson/prompts. 'say' is how a line is spoken when it holds numbers; score.py compares what a speech recognizer hears with it.

reference.ru: Йоу! Я Джексон. Скажи, что сделать, — и считай, что уже сделано.
reference.en: Yo! I'm Jackson. Tell me what you need, and consider it done.

lines.text: Здарова! Я Джексон. Говори, что делаем.
Готово: громкость 70%, встреча в 15:30, до неё два часа.
lines.say: Готово: громкость семьдесят процентов, встреча в пятнадцать тридцать, до неё два часа.

lines.text: Проверил систему: всё чисто. Процессор отдыхает, памяти свободно две трети. Можем работать.
Hey! I'm Jackson. What are we doing?
Done: volume at 70%, the meeting is at 3:30 PM, two hours from now.
lines.say: Done: volume at seventy percent, the meeting is at three thirty PM, two hours from now.

lines.text: System check complete: all clear. The processor is resting and two thirds of the memory are free. Let's get to work.

designs.name: Кентафурик
designs.instruct: Male, about 25 years old, warm baritone with a bright, lively tone. Speaks casually and a little fast, relaxed and confident, with a playful, cheeky smile in the voice, like a friendly host of a late-night internet radio show. Clear diction.

designs.name: Спокойный помощник
designs.instruct: Male, about 45 years old, low and smooth voice, calm and composed. Speaks at an even, measured pace with precise diction and a subtle dry wit, like an unflappable, polite personal assistant who has everything under control. Warm, never hurried.

designs.name: Диспетчер
designs.instruct: Male, about 35 years old, crisp mid-range voice, energetic and focused. Short, clipped phrases with clear professional diction, like a radio dispatcher reading out a status report. Confident and efficient.

designs.name: Пиратское радио
designs.instruct: Male, about 40 years old, husky low voice with a lazy, charismatic drawl, like a late-night pirate radio DJ. Relaxed and smoky, with a grin in the voice and a slow groove in the phrasing.
